title: Flickr Publish Backlog
dataSources: Lightroom photo exports (`lightroom:photo`), Flickr photo metadata (`flickr:photo`), ShutterCount body audits (`shuttercount:camera`), and F3 card tests (`f3:card`).
app: Adobe Lightroom exports, Flickr API metadata, ShutterCount camera audits, and F3 SD-card health checks sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=lightroom:photo publish_target="flickr") OR (index=personal sourcetype=flickr:photo)
| eval pending=if(sourcetype="lightroom:photo" AND publish_state!="published",1,0)
| stats sum(pending) as backlog, count(eval(sourcetype="flickr:photo")) as published by collection_name
| sort - backlog
description: Compares Lightroom export intent with actual Flickr publishes to show where galleries are backing up.
value: A publish backlog is a hidden form of lost work: the edits exist, but nobody ever sees them.
implementation: Stamp Lightroom exports with a Flickr publish target and compare them with Flickr API inventory by collection.
visualization: Table of collections with backlog size and published count.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which photo sets are waiting around half-finished instead of actually getting posted.
